name: Public Speaking
overview: Scripture reveals that public speaking is ultimately empowered and guided by God, who forms the mouth and equips His servants with the words to speak, as seen in His assurance to Moses that He will be with his mouth and teach him what to say. Believers are encouraged not to fear opposition or judgment because God promises His presence, strength, and deliverance. This divine enablement assures that when facing challenges in proclaiming the gospel, one need not worry about how to respond, trusting that the Lord will provide the necessary words and courage.
